## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Stage-1 uses BS-synthetic pricing; no actual contracts traded. For reference, the baseline P&L appears to be per-contract (no position sizing applied). Real account sizing would scale these numbers.
2. **Sample bias:** The Stage-1 run uses BS-synthetic over historical SPY/VIX bars (no real OPRA). Sample size includes all days in 2025-Q1 through 2026-Q2 as shown in quarter_pnl. Overfit risk: high because BS-synthetic may not reflect real fills and the empty combo represents no strategy.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (Stage-1 is in-sample; walk-forward OOS not yet performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (BS-synthetic only).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: 2025-Q1 -$1300.5 loss; max drawdown from JSON: 4701.52; blow-up scenario: large losses in Q1, Q3, Q4.
